K1: key_n[0]/N2 decrement once on release; single long also once
K2: key_n[1]/M2 increment once on release; single long also once
ABA: new generation on each applied change, never threshold value used as generation
saturation: no real change = no generation increment/revoke
LAST: retained across config changes; original epoch-change reset retained
MSK: same production closing3x3 edge mask, not a filled object silhouette
latency: unchanged production pixel pipeline; metadata is attached to the existing adapter tags
